column1: # AME2020 mass excesses, the A = 9 isobar chain. Supplied by M 2026-08-11,
# NOT fetched — the IAEA host is proxy-blocked and the mirrors are untried.
# VERIFIED three ways before writing:
#   1. B = Z*7288.97106 + N*8071.31806 - Delta reproduces the known B/A to
#      0.1 keV for 9Li, 9Be, 9B and 9C. The 9He check failed on MY reference
#      constant (I used 8He's 3924.5 keV); the supplied value gives 3348.7,
#      which is the correct drop across the neutron dripline.
#   2. S_p(9B) = Delta(8Be) + Delta(1H) - Delta(9B) = -185.06 keV, so 9B is
#      PROTON-UNBOUND as the source states — derived, not asserted.
#   3. 9Be carries the lowest mass excess and the chain has a single minimum,
#      the parabola in Z the mass formula requires.
# *** SUPERSEDED 2026-08-11 (R 1548) by the FETCHED file at
# https://www.anl.gov/sites/www/files/2021-05/mass_1.mas20.txt ***
# Checked against the source: 3 of 5 values match to 0.01 keV, but
#   9Be  uncertainty supplied 0.04    source 0.076
# The transcription was good to ~1 keV on values and UNRELIABLE on
# uncertainties. It passed the physics checks because those are coarse at
# that scale. USE THE SOURCE FILE, not this.
# Z
